name: Debutante
text: Once per game: double your silver. Each rival +2 silver.

name: Grand Host
text: Double the silver you gain from Silver spaces.

name: Guest
text: Whenever a rival gives you something, +1 more of it.

name: Heir
text: On Recruit: +1 silver per member you have. Round III Start: +1 silver per member you have.

name: Majordomo
text: Whenever you take a Silver space, +2 silver.

name: Retinue
text: Worth 3 followers. On Recruit: each rival +1 silver.

name: Revelers
text: Counts as 3 members.

name: Patron Saint
text: Game end: +1 follower per 2 silver members, anyone’s.

name: Upstart
text: On Recruit: gain half the silver of the rival with the most, rounded up.

name: Admirer
text: Whenever a rival recruits a member of a color you have none of, +1 of that color.

name: Chefs
text: Worth 2 followers. Once per game: +1 of each color in round I, +2 in round II, +3 in round III.

name: Dyer
text: Round end: +1 yellow per color you hold.

name: Explorer
text: Whenever you take a space outside Yellow, +1 yellow.

name: Farmer
text: Whenever an action gains you yellow, +1 yellow.

name: Go-Between
text: Whenever you recruit a non-yellow member, +1 of its color.

name: Late Bloomers
text: Worth 2 followers. On Recruit: if no rival has fewer followers than you (not counting this card), +1 of each color. Round Start: if no rival has fewer followers than you (not counting this card), +1 of each color.

name: Peddler
text: On Recruit: +1 of each color. Round Start: +1 of each color.

name: Pilgrim
text: On Recruit: +1 of each color.

name: Rainmaker
text: Once per game: raise each of your colors to match your yellow.

name: Weaver
text: Whenever you buy 5 or more followers, +1 of each color.
